title: PayeeAccount (DRAFT)
description: A party who may receive money, once the provider has verified them (FIN-008). DRAFT — not approved.

partyId.description: OPEN QUESTION 6: the landowning company and the caretaker are different parties with different economic interests. Both can be payees; which one is intended must be explicit.

providerAccountRef.description: The provider's identifier for the onboarded business.

verificationStatus.description: Set from the provider's KYB outcome. Only 'verified' may be paid.

payoutCurrency.description: Often differs from the sponsorship currency, requiring an explicit fx_conversion (FIN-005). Open question 8: who bears the movement between commitment and payout.

_notDefinedDeliberately.bankAccountNumber: Never stored here. Bank details live with the provider. Substituting a payee's bank details is the classic payment fraud, and the safest place for them is somewhere this platform cannot alter.
_notDefinedDeliberately.taxIdentifier: Held by the provider as part of KYB.
